topic: Archive Module Behavior and Delivery Receipt
evidence: Archive finalizes completed execution. Called by Executor after all waves complete. Steps: 1) read all wave receipts from .wabblespec/receipts/; 2) run Verifier pre-archive sweep (non-blocking — checks completeness, correctness, coherence; findings as WARN in archive receipt pre_archive_sweep field; Archive proceeds regardless); 3) aggregate all receipts into one delivery receipt; 4) bump version; 5) append CHANGELOG entry; 6) write delivery receipt to .wabblespec/archive/receipt-index.json. Task is not done until Archive runs (I10). 32 entries in receipt-index.json as of 2026-05-25. Archive owns shift+nexus triggers. Depends on verifier, shift, nexus.
